questions.stem: Calculate the weight of a 5 kg object on Earth (g = 9.8 m/s²).
questions.explanation: Weight = mass x gravitational field strength = 5 x 9.8 = 49 N.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about mass?

options.text: Mass changes depending on where you are
Mass is measured using a spring balance
Mass is the amount of matter in an object and does not change with location

questions.explanation: Mass is the amount of matter in an object. It is a scalar quantity that remains constant regardless of location. Weight, not mass, changes with gravitational field strength.
